title: Ensemble Diversity V2: 6-Verifier AND-Composition Measurement
k5_subset_drop: ThinkPRMProbe OR Z3MathVerifier (the rogue pair at r=0.506)
operator_finding: Empirically confirms k-ceiling Round 2 prediction: cross-mechanism diversity (Z3+AST+Semantic added in exp1107) successfully drives 14 of 15 pairwise correlations below the 0.5 threshold. The single violating pair (ThinkPRMProbe vs Z3MathVerifier at r=0.506) reflects that step-level reasoning probes share signal with formal logic — a finding that informs Phase-1d verifier-suite design. Dropping either probe yields a viable k=5 ensemble. AT k=6, max r exceeds 0.5 by a small margin; at the recommended k=5 subset, max r = 0.462. This is empirical validation of the k_max≈7-8 architectural assumption from k-ceiling Round 2.

baseline_exp1093.note: Baseline: 3 Tier-0 text probes with max r=0.656; AND-composition not viable
